parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') - interval '90 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AS cutoff,
    $1::boolean AS dry_run
),
deleted_calendar AS (
  DELETE FROM calendar_logs WHERE created_at < (SELECT cutoff FROM params) AND NOT (SELECT dry_run FROM params) RETURNING 1
),
deleted_errors AS (
  DELETE FROM error_logs WHERE created_at < (SELECT cutoff FROM params) AND NOT (SELECT dry_run FROM params) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_calendar) >= 0 RETURNING 1
),
deleted_notifications AS (
  DELETE FROM notification_logs WHERE created_at < (SELECT cutoff FROM params) AND NOT (SELECT dry_run FROM params) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_errors) >= 0 RETURNING 1
),
deleted_mail AS (
  DELETE FROM mail_logs WHERE created_at < (SELECT cutoff FROM params) AND NOT (SELECT dry_run FROM params) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_notifications) >= 0 RETURNING 1
),
deleted_runs AS (
  DELETE FROM workflow_runs WHERE created_at < (SELECT cutoff FROM params) AND NOT (SELECT dry_run FROM params) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_mail) >= 0 RETURNING 1
)
SELECT
  params.dry_run,
  params.cutoff,
  CASE WHEN params.dry_run THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM calendar_logs WHERE created_at < params.cutoff) ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_calendar) END AS calendar_logs_count,
  CASE WHEN params.dry_run THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM error_logs WHERE created_at < params.cutoff) ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_errors) END AS error_logs_count,
  CASE WHEN params.dry_run THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM notification_logs WHERE created_at < params.cutoff) ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_notifications) END AS notification_logs_count,
  CASE WHEN params.dry_run THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM mail_logs WHERE created_at < params.cutoff) ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_mail) END AS mail_logs_count,
  CASE WHEN params.dry_run THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_runs WHERE created_at < params.cutoff) ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_runs) END AS workflow_runs_count
FROM params;
